title: Doc
description: A reading page: the section's progress, the text at 42rem with the previous and next page at its end, and beside it on a wide screen (after it on a narrow one) the table of contents and the section's pages.

title.description: The page's heading, its title in the navigation and in search results

description.description: One sentence under the heading (under the links line on a case page), and the page's description for search results

liveSite.description: A case page's links line, under the heading: the site's address, shown as "Live site". The line is always Live site, Repository, Style guide, in that order, each only when set

repository.description: A case page's links line: the site's public repository, shown as "Repository"

styleGuide.description: A case page's links line: the site's published style guide, shown as "Style guide"

page.description: What the storefront works out for the page

next.description: The page after this one in the navigation

regions.description: The layout's regions: the sidebar, with the table of contents first, empty when the page has neither

section.description: The section the page is in, for "In this section" (molecules/section-nav)

prev.description: The page before this one in the navigation
